FX-REPEAT-001.says: The settings as they start: Unfold, nothing grown, no blending. The picture as it was, and nothing grows.

FX-REPEAT-002.says: Repeat: the picture copied as it is, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-003.says: Checker Flip H: every other copy, as a chequerboard, flipped across, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-004.says: Checker Flip V: every other copy flipped down, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-005.says: Unfold: copies flipped across in odd columns and down in odd rows, so they meet edge to matching edge, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-006.says: Checker 180: every other copy turned half round, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-007.says: Checker Flip 45: every other copy flipped on its diagonal, squeezed to the tile's shape, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-008.says: Checker 90 CW: every other copy turned a quarter clockwise, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-009.says: Checker 90 CCW: every other copy turned a quarter anticlockwise, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-010.says: Rosette: each square of four copies turned a quarter on round it, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-011.says: Random: each copy one of the eight ways, chosen by its place, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-012.says: None: the room grows but stays clear, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-013.says: Turn CW: each copy a quarter turn clockwise on from the one before it, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-014.says: Turn CCW: each copy a quarter turn anticlockwise on, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-015.says: Twist: turning clockwise across and anticlockwise down, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-016.says: Slide: the edge pixels drawn on outwards, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-017.says: Brick: copies as they are, every other row moved half a tile across, grown 5 across and 3 down each way.

FX-REPEAT-018.says: Repeat, grown 4 right, 1 left, 2 up and none down: the layer grows 4 both ways across and 2 both ways down, the room past each expansion clear.

FX-REPEAT-019.says: Repeat, nothing grown, Blend Borders 50: the picture's own edges mixed with its middle, ready to repeat without a seam.

FX-REPEAT-020.says: Repeat grown all round, Blend Borders 100: the copies meet with no seam.

FX-REPEAT-021.says: Unfold grown all round, Blend Borders 100: Unfold ignores the blending and is FX-REPEAT-005.

FX-REPEAT-022.says: Expand Right keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 6 at frame 4, linear, Repeat: frame 1 is 1.5, rounded up to 2; frame 2 is 3.

FX-REPEAT-023.says: Blend Borders keyed from 50 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end, Repeat grown all round: frame 2 would pass 100, is held at 100, and is FX-REPEAT-020.

FX-REPEAT-024.says: FX-REPEAT-002 moved three pixels right: the copies move with the drawing and the three columns left bare stay empty.

FX-REPEAT-025.says: After a drop shadow that grows the layer to 10 by 8, Checker Flip H grown 2 each way: the copies are of the grown layer, shadow and all.

FX-REPEAT-026.says: Expand Right -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-REPEAT-027.says: Expand Up 4001, above 4000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-REPEAT-028.says: Tiling "wallpaper", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-REPEAT-029.says: Blend Borders 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-REPEAT-030.says: Expand Left keyed to 5000 at frame 4, above 4000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
